variable.name: position
variable.script: {(row.version_id, row.function_id): row for row in positions}[(this.version_id, this.function_id)]

key.name: r1_employed
key.script: any(row.person_id == this.person_id and row.company_id == position.company_id and row.function_id == this.function_id for row in employments)

key.name: r2_licensed
key.script: any(row.person_id == this.person_id and row.license_type == policy.base_license and row.status == policy.active_status and row.expires_on is not None and row.expires_on >= position.valid_on for row in person_licenses)

key.name: r3_qualified
key.script: any(row.person_id == this.person_id and row.qualification_id == policy.required_qualification[this.function_id] for row in person_qualifications)

variable.name: people
variable.script: [row.person_id for row in plan if row.version_id == this.version_id and row.function_id == this.function_id]

variable.name: position_of
variable.script: {(row.version_id, row.function_id): row for row in positions}

variable.name: held
variable.script: [position_of[(row.version_id, row.function_id)] for row in plan if row.person_id in people]

key.name: approval_exclusive
key.script: all(other['approval_id'] == this.approval_id for other in held if this.exclusive or other['exclusive'])

key.name: company_exclusive
key.script: all(other['company_id'] == this.company_id for other in held)
